title: Matrix cocycle descent produces a bijective base algebra homomorphism
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sc-galois-matrix-cocycle-split, there exists a K-algebra homomorphism f : D → M_n(K) that is bijective as a function.

source.place: Tag 03R7, tensor computation and injectivity via vector-space descent

proof.text: Perform finite Galois descent after trivializing the locally constant cocycle by matrix Hilbert 90; the descended map is injective and surjective by faithful scalar extension.

proof_origin.place: Expanded steps of Tag 03R7 and Section 0DVG
